subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should gateway pricing retain the proposed 4,096-entry recency-eviction policy for oversized dynamic model catalogs?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the capacity and intentional eviction of less-recent model pricing are long-term runtime behavior choices that tests cannot select on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept the bounded recency policy
options.body: Merge the PR with 4,096 as the gateway pricing-cache retention cap and accept refetches for less-recent rows after oversized refreshes.

options.title: Choose a different retention contract
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a different capacity or retention policy before requesting a focused revision.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recency policy
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with 4,096 as the gateway pricing-cache retention cap and accept refetches for less-recent rows after oversized refreshes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline ties steipete to review of the competing cache-bound implementation, providing the best available routing signal for the policy choice.
